summary: Re-tested the user's bug report ONLY on PREVIEW (frontend). I could NOT reproduce either bug. BUG 1: qa_varela set to sections:['liquidaciones'] logs in and lands on /veraos/liquidaciones. The sidebar shows ONLY 'Liquidaciones'. The screen loads with data (property A161, 4 reservations), and clicking a reservation opens the full liquidación detail (Alquiler / Comisión / Gastos / Neto, PDF, movements). Typing /veraos/hoy, /propiedades, /alquileres or /equipo in the URL bar sends you back to /veraos/liquidaciones. No page errors. BUG 2: qa_temp (sections:null, password QaPilot!2026xz works) sees Alquileres + Studio. The global list (Reservas tab) shows 'Editar datos' (rt-edit-huesped-{id}) on every row: Pre-reservas 1/1, Finalizadas 6/6. Confirmadas has 0 reservations, so there was nothing to check there. In the A161 workspace, the Reservas tab shows rt-wsedit-huesped-{id} on all 7 rows. In both places the modal opens with the fields pre-filled (nombre, tel, email, DNI, huéspedes, importe, depósito, limpieza, historial). No console errors and no 4xx/5xx responses. Conclusion: the code works on preview, so the most likely cause is that production is outdated (needs a redeploy).

issues: The 'Ajustar movimientos' date field uses the browser's native date picker (mm/dd/yyyy format) instead of a shadcn calendar. Minor.

They did not reproduce in the next run, which tracked responses. Likely data fetches from restricted screens before the redirect. Harmless, but worth a look.
critical_code_review_comments: AppLayout: the redirect useEffect uses the employeeSectionIds/EMPLOYEE_PATHS values without listing them as dependencies (eslint rule disabled). It works because the effect re-runs on pathname/isEmployee changes, but if an admin changes sections while the user's session is open, the user won't be redirected until they navigate again.
